index.description.001: iE-Ink Assistant ilungisa umahluko, iinkcukacha zezithunzi nombala kwizikrini ze-e-ink zemacOS neWindows.
index.text.013: Lungisa umahluko wombhalo, iinkcukacha zezithunzi nombala kwizikrini ze-e-ink ozikhethayo. Ezinye izikrini zakho azitshintshi.
index.text.022: UMAHLUKO WOMBHALO ✦ IINKCUKACHA ZEZITHUNZI ✦ UKUTYEBA KOMBALA + RGB ✦ IISETTINGI EZILUNGISELELWE ISIKRINI NGASINYE ✦ UMAHLUKO WOMBHALO ✦ IINKCUKACHA ZEZITHUNZI ✦ UKUTYEBA KOMBALA + RGB ✦ IISETTINGI EZILUNGISELELWE ISIKRINI NGASINYE ✦
index.text.025: Umahluko wombhalo wenza amaphepha okufunda abe mnyama. Ukuphucula ividiyo kubonisa iinkcukacha ezimnyama zomfanekiso. Ukutyeba kombala neRGB kunceda iiphaneli ze-e-ink ezinemibala.
index.alt.026: Umzekelo womahluko wephepha lokufunda phambi nasemva
index.text.028: Wenza umbhalo oyintloko nowesibini ofipheleyo ube mnyama ukuze ufundeke.
index.alt.029: Umzekelo weenkcukacha zezithunzi kumhlaba phambi nasemva
index.text.031: Kukhanyisa iithoni ezimnyama zeefoto neevidiyo ukubonisa iinkcukacha zezithunzi.
index.alt.032: Umzekelo wezityalo ezingashukumiyo kwi-e-ink enemibala phambi nasemva
index.text.034: Buyekeza imibala efipheleyo ngokuTyeba kombala neRGB.
index.text.035: Imiboniso eyimizekelo. Iziphumo ziyahluka ngokwephaneli nangomxholo wokuqala.
index.text.040: I-app isebenzisa izilawuli zesikrini zikawonke-wonke ezikhoyo kwinkqubo yokusebenza nganye. Izilawuli ezingaxhaswayo ziyafihlwa okanye zichazwe.
index.text.042: Umahluko wombhalo, Ukuphucula ividiyo, amagophe, iisetingi ezilungiselelweyo neesetingi zesikrini ngasinye.
index.text.044: Ukunciphisa ukungcangcazela nokulawula iNight Shift / True Tone kwisikrini ngasinye.
index.text.046: Iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zeWindows 10 2004 neWindows 11 21H2+; ukufumaneka kuxhomekeke kwinkqubo nakwihardware.
index.text.049: Umahluko wombhalo unamanqanaba amane kumaphepha anomahluko ophantsi.
index.text.050: Wusebenzise xa ufunda; wahlukile kuKuphucula ividiyo.
index.text.053: Ukuphucula ividiyo kuveza iinkcukacha zezithunzi kwiifoto nakwiividiyo.
index.text.054: Kucime xa ufunda kuba kukhanyisa nombhalo omnyama.
index.text.057: Sebenzisa iisetingi ezilungiselelweyo okanye izilawuli ezithe ngqo ukubuyekeza uluhlu lwemibala oluncinci.
index.text.058: Ukufumaneka kuxhomekeke kwinkqubo yokusebenza, kwiGPU, kwidrayiva nakwindlela yokubonisa.
index.text.061: Phawula kuphela izikrini ze-e-ink ofuna i-app izitshintshe.
index.text.062: Gcina amagophe ezikrini ezahlukeneyo uze ubuyisele iisetingi xa i-app iphuma.
index.alt.063: Izilawuli ezongezelelekileyo zegophe leethoni zeE-Ink Assistant ngesiNgesi
index.text.066: Tshintsha indawo yokugoba, igamma, indawo emnyama nendawo emhlophe ngoxa ujonga igophe.
index.text.067: Gcina ukuya kutsho kwiisetingi ezilungiselelweyo ezintlanu ezinamagama. Iisetingi zigcinwa ngokwahlukeneyo kwisikrini ngasinye.
index.text.082: Amanqanaba amane: Phakathi, Mandla, Bukhali, Qinile
index.text.085: Umhleli wegophe ophilayo neesetingi ezintlanu ezinamagama
index.text.087: Iprofayile yombala kwisikrini ngasinye; ukutyeba kombala 0%–300% neRGB 0%–200%
index.text.088: Kufumaneka kwiinkqubo ezifanelekileyo zeWindows 10 2004 neWindows 11 21H2+; indlela ekhoyo ixhomekeke kwinkqubo nakwihardware
index.text.090: Kufumaneka kwizikrini zangaphandle ezixhaswayo; kuvula xa isikrini siphawulwe njenge-e-ink
index.text.091: Akufumaneki. iWindows ayinasilawuli sikawonke-wonke esifanayo sokudibanisa iithoni ngamachaphaza kwisikrini ngasinye, kwaye iinkqubo ezininzi zeWindows mhlawumbi azisidingi.
index.text.093: Kufumaneka ngomncedisi oqinisekiswa ngumsebenzisi kube kanye
index.text.094: Kufumaneka ukususela kwiWindows 7 SP1 ngeeAPI zenkqubo ezihambelanayo
index.text.097: Imo ekhanyayo yeWindows yeseshoni kuphela kwiWindows 10 1903+
index.text.099: Ukukhupha isikrini ngasinye kwiNight Shift neTrue Tone; kufuna imvume yomlawuli nokuqhagamshela kwakhona
index.text.100: Iisetingi zesibane sasebusuku ukususela kwiWindows 10 1703+; isilawuli esithe ngqo sokusicima kwiWindows 11 24H2+
index.text.102: Izikrini ezibonisa umfanekiso omnye zisakhethwa ngokwahlukeneyo
index.text.103: Amagophe eethoni achaphazela umthombo ekwabelwana ngawo; Ukutyeba kombala neRGB zifuna imo yokwandisa
index.text.105: Amagophe ethutyana, iiprofayile zombala nokudibanisa iithoni ngamachaphaza kuyabuyiselwa xa uphuma; ukukhutshwa kwiNight Shift / True Tone kuhlala kukho
index.text.106: Utshintsho lwethutyana lwegamma, lombala, lwezinto ezibonwayo nolwesibane sasebusuku luyabuyiselwa xa uphuma; umbala nesibane sasebusuku ziyabuyiselwa nasemva kokuphuma okungaqhelekanga
index.text.110: IsiNgesi, isiTshayina esenziwe lula, isiTshayina semveli, isiJapan
index.text.112: Kuphela xa ukhetha ukukhupha kwiNight Shift / True Tone
index.text.116: Zombini iinguqulelo zisimahla kwaye zinekhowudi evulelekileyo.
index.text.117: macOS 2.6↓Windows 1.2↓
index.text.118: macOS 14+ Apple silicon · Windows 7 SP1–11 x64
index.text.123: Zama ukuvula i-app kube kanye. Ukuba imacOS iyayivimba, vula Iisetingi zenkqubo → Ubumfihlo & Nokhuseleko uze ukhethe Vula nangona kunjalo.
index.text.124: Le software iphuhliswe ngokuzimeleyo kwaye ayikho kwiApp Store ngoku. imacOS iza kubonisa isilumkiso sokuba ayikwazi ukuyiqinisekisa xa uyivula okokuqala. Ikhowudi ivulelekile ngokupheleleyo, ngoko ungayihlola ngaphambi kokuthatha isigqibo sokuyisebenzisa.
index.text.126: Emva kokusa i-app kuApplications, vula iTerminal uze usebenzise:
index.text.128: Khuphela imacOS 2.6 ↓Ukuba iyanceda, nika iprojekthi inkwenkwezi kwiGitHub ↗
index.text.133: Vula iE‑Ink Assistant kwimenyu yokuqala okanye kwitreyi yenkqubo.
index.text.134: YeWindows 7 SP1 ukuya kwiWindows 11 kwiikhompyutha ze-x64. Izilawuli ezikhoyo zixhomekeke kwinguqulelo yeWindows, kwiGPU, kwidrayiva nakuqhagamshelo lwesikrini.
index.text.135: Khuphela iWindows 1.2 ↓Ukuba iyanceda, nika iprojekthi inkwenkwezi kwiGitHub ↗
changelog.description.138: Imbali yeenguqulelo zeE-Ink Assistant zemacOS neWindows.
changelog.text.145: Inkxaso yezikrini ezibonisa umfanekiso omnye iphuculwe.
changelog.text.146: Izikrini zesibini eziphinda umfanekiso ngehardware zisakhethwa ngokwahlukeneyo kwaye zilungiswa ngokuphuma ngakunye kwehardware.
changelog.text.147: Ukutshintsha phakathi kokuphinda umfanekiso nokwandisa kuhlaziya ngokukhawuleza kuze kuphinde kufake iisetingi zesikrini.
changelog.text.148: Ukufaka kwakhona nokubuyisela xa uphuma kuchukumisa kuphela iiphaneli eziphawulwe njenge-e-ink, kuquka nezikrini eziqhagamshelweyo eziphinda umfanekiso.
changelog.text.149: Icebiso lokuseta ngoku libhekisa ngokucacileyo kwimenyu yesikrini ngokwaso.
changelog.text.152: Isikhumbuzi esifihlekayo ngoku sibonakala ngaphezu kwezilawuli, sinomzekelo weBigme B251 Pro.
changelog.text.153: Ndiyaqonda kufihla isikhumbuzi kwiseshoni; Sukuphinda ubonise kuhlala kunjalo nasemva kokuqalisa kwakhona.
changelog.text.154: Iphaneli yokwamkela ngoku isebenzisa iingongoma ezintathu ezimfutshane zokuseta ezinee-ayikhoni.
changelog.text.155: Izikrini ezakhelwe ngaphakathi ngoku zivela emva kwezikrini zangaphandle kuluhlu lokukhetha.
changelog.text.159: Iphaneli yolawulo ngoku isebenzisa ukuphakama okubonakalayo kwesikrini esinento yebha yemenyu.
changelog.text.160: Umxholo omde uyaskroleka ushiye amanqaku angama40 ngaphezu kweDock okanye komphetho wesikrini. Iiphaneli ezimfutshane zigcina ukuphakama kwazo kwendalo.
changelog.text.162: Kutshintshwe amaxabiso eesetingi ezilungiselelweyo zoMahluko wombhalo.
changelog.text.163: Phakathi isebenzisa igophe langaphambili elithi Mandla. Mandla, Bukhali noQinile ziba mnyama ngokulandelelana.
changelog.text.164: Bukhali isebenzisa igamma 5.00 nendawo emnyama 0.10. Qinile isebenzisa igamma 6.00 nendawo emnyama 0.34. Zombini zisusa iinkcukacha ezingwevu ezingakumbi zize zenze imiphetho ibe lukhuni.
changelog.text.167: Kulungiswe ukutshintsha ulwimi kwicandelo Indlela esebenza ngayo.
changelog.text.168: Isihloko secandelo neqhosha elithi Bonisa ngakumbi / Bonisa kancinci ngoku zitshintsha ngoko nangoko xa ulwimi lwe-app lutshintsha.
changelog.text.171: Umncedisi angasebenza xa iMac itshixiwe, ethintela izilumkiso zeShortcuts xa kuqhawulwa naxa kubuyiselwa.
changelog.text.172: Abasebenzisi abaphucula ukusuka kuv2.0 kufuneka bongeze umncedisi othiywe ngokutsha kube kanye, baze basuse omdala xa befuna.
changelog.text.175: Kongezwe izilawuli zesikrini, iilwimi nesifakeli seDMG.
changelog.text.176: Kongezwe izilawuli zeRGB, Night Shift neTrue Tone kwisikrini ngasinye.
changelog.text.177: Kongezwe ukunciphisa ukubonakala ngaphaya nentshukumo ngomncedisi weShortcuts oqinisekiswa ngumsebenzisi.
changelog.text.178: Kongezwe isiNgesi, isiTshayina esenziwe lula, isiTshayina semveli nesiJapan.
changelog.text.180: Kongezwe ulawulo lweNight Shift neTrue Tone kwisikrini ngasinye.
changelog.text.181: Utshintsho lufuna igama lokugqitha lomlawuli nokuqhagamshela isikrini kwakhona. Alurhoxiswa xa uphuma kwi-app.
changelog.text.184: Kongezwe Ukunciphisa ukungcangcazela, Ukutyeba kombala, Umahluko wombhalo, Ukuphucula ividiyo, amagophe eethoni enziwe ngokwakho, iindawo zokugcina amagophe nokubuyisela izikrini xa uphuma.
changelog.text.188: Kulungiswe izilumkiso ezingachanekanga zokungaphumeleli kophawu xa iWindows iveza indlela yokusebenza kombala kodwa ingavumeli i-app itshintshe imeko yayo.
changelog.text.189: Idatha yokubuyisela iyagcinwa ngelixa imo yokuphinda umfanekiso icima ulawulo lombala okwethutyana, ize ibuyiselwe xa ulungelelwaniso lwezikrini olulawulekayo lubuya.
changelog.text.191: Kongezwe Umahluko wombhalo, Ukuphucula ividiyo, amagophe ongezelelekileyo, iisetingi ezilungiselelweyo nokukhetha izikrini ze-e-ink kwisikrini ngasinye.
changelog.text.192: Kongezwe izilawuli ezihambelanayo zokutyeba kombala, RGB, imo ekhanyayo yeWindows nesibane sasebusuku, kunye nokubuyisela nokuchacha emva kokuwa kwe-app.
changelog.text.193: Kongezwe ukuphathwa kwezikrini eziphinda umfanekiso, isikhokelo setreyi yenkqubo, ukuqala xa ungena, uhlaziyo nesifakeli esineelwimi ezininzi.
